verdict.rationale: Datalab provides building blocks for background processing: versioned pipelines that chain processors and deploy to production, published agent processors, and webhooks that notify you when async jobs complete so you don't have to poll. However, every job still has to be started by the user's own API or SDK call, and nothing shows a built-in way to make automations run on their own. Missing for 10: scheduled or recurring runs, event triggers such as watched folders or inbound sources, hands-on corroboration of autonomous background operation.
